snippet.text:
structure Leading (B : F.Coeff →ₗ[ℂ] F.Coeff) (c : ℝ) : Prop where
  price : 1 ≤ c
  cap (i j : F.Index) : ‖B (column F j) i‖ ≤ c
  diagonal (i : F.Index) : 1 ≤ c * ‖B (column F i) i‖
  triangular (i j : F.Index) (hN : j ≠ i) : B (column F j) i ≠ 0 → (F.grades j).1 < (F.grades i).1
  unit : B F.e0 = F.e0

proof_context.conclusion: `Leading B c` states `B` fixes the unit `e0`, is triangular in the grades (`B (column j) i ≠ 0 → grade j < grade i`), has nonzero diagonal (`1 ≤ c*‖diagonal‖`) and entries bounded by `c`.

snippet.text:
structure Heading (F : Labels.Frame G d) where
  map : F.Coeff ≃ₗ[ℂ] F.Coeff
  core_comm x : map (F.core x) = F.core (map x)
  covariant x m : map (Motion.patch F m x)=Motion.patch F m (map x)
  unit : map F.e0 = F.e0

proof_context.conclusion: `Heading.map` is invertible, fixes the unit and commutes with `core`, so preserves the nonconstant part.

structure Prints (T:Heading F)(u ζ v:ℝ)(S:GaugeDoor (H.rep N p (m+1)) (H.rep N p m))(X:Wing→Prop):Prop where
  heading z: F.coeffSize (T.map z) ≤ u * F.coeffSize z ∧ F.coeffSize (T.map.symm z) ≤ u*F.coeffSize z
  main i:let x:= Size.axis F i; let Q:= Extra.Histories.primary (0:Site f) x
    Span B H N p m Y (tell (P.main i)) (Q.exponentialEntry 0 B E) 0 (x 0) S X (Q.density 0 B E) (T.leads L x) (ζ*F.coeffSize (F.core x)) (u*F.coeffSize (vowel F L (F.core x))) v
  regular i U t: let b:= mapSeat (n:=f) i; let x:=(E).p.mass b t -- f unknown in mapSeat
    RegFit E 0 d Y b U→ (E).p.supBounds 0 b U t→ Span B H N p m Y (tell (P.tint i U)) (masked (E).p.threshold b U) 0 0 S X (Extra.Histories.salary (E) b U) 0 (ζ*x) (ζ*x) (2*x)
  forced i U t: let a:=(E).p.mass ((E).activities.forced i).support t
    U≠0→ X (.gasKey i)→ SlotFit E 0 i U→ 0 ≤ t → (∀ V, ‖U V‖ ≤ t) → Span B H N p m Y (tell (P.ink i U)) 0 (exactGas (E).activities i U) 0 S X (Extra.Histories.fare E i U) 0 (ζ*(a/κ)) (ζ*(a/κ)) (2*a)
  blank i: P.ink i 0=0

proof_context.conclusion: `Prints.heading` bounds the two operator norms of `T.map` by `u`; the `main`, `regular`, `forced` fields carry the local remainder estimates.
